_comment: cortex-drive runtime alerts (RV-17; design documents/architecture/safe-errors-and-alerts-design-2026-11-18.md §3). Applied by scripts/setup-alerts.sh (dry run by default). Spend alerts are finops-admin's, not here. {{PROJECT}} and {{UPTIME_CHECK_ID}} are filled in by the script. Policy names start with policy_prefix so --status/--disable/--snooze/--remove find exactly these. Log-match policies (conditionMatchedLog) carry rate_limit: Cloud Monitoring requires a notification rate limit for them, and a metric policy must name one resource type, which denials across services cannot.

log_metrics.name: cortex_user_errors
log_metrics.description: Gateway failures by class (user_error event, S2-90). Label code = ai_unavailable | ai_busy | graph_unavailable | timeout | internal.

policies.name: AI provider unavailable
policies.doc: OpenAI refused the gateway's calls (credit used up or key revoked). Users see "Cortex-Drive can't answer questions right now". Check the balance: documents/paid-services-and-billing.md (OpenAI). Daily check 8.

policies.name: knowledge graph down
policies.doc: /api/system-status has not reported neo4j up for 10 minutes. Users see "The knowledge graph is temporarily unavailable". Check the Aura instance: https://console.neo4j.io (documents/paid-services-and-billing.md).

policies.name: service account denied
policies.doc: A cortex-drive service account was denied a permission (RV-15 identities). Find the line: daily check 6 in documents/operations-daily-checks.md; grants are listed in the RV-15 design notes. A log-match alert: at most one email per 5 minutes while denials continue.

policies.name: job failed
policies.doc: A Cloud Run job execution failed (cortex-finops-push, cortex-ingest-worker, permify-migrate or cortex-maintenance: the daily retention purge + orphan sweep). Logs: gcloud run jobs executions list --job <job> --region us-central1.

policies.name: error spike
policies.doc: More than 5 internal, timeout or busy failures in 10 minutes. Daily check 5 in documents/operations-daily-checks.md; roll back with documents/cloud-run-traffic-runbook.md if a release caused it. Threshold: scripts/alerts.json (RV-23).
